d: An anthropomorphic donkey with a slender build, featuring grey skin and fur with a dark charcoal mane. The face has a mature expression with narrow, dark brown eyes. The attire consists of a white long-sleeved shirt under a red sleeveless tunic, paired with dark brown trousers and knee-high brown leather boots. Accessories include a small red pillbox hat, two brown leather belts with a small side pouch, a handheld rectangular mirror, and a flower crown of pink roses held near the head. BODY COLOR: grey
